lines.label: Change
lines.note: : Grants all champions the ability to become camouflage if they stay out of combat for 1.5 seconds. Attacking or casting abilities ends the stealth immediately, but it can be regained from leaving combat.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: : Every 12 seconds, she dashes to the most wounded ally and heal them based on their missing health, as well as surrounds them with Hallowed Mist}}. The mist affects all champions on both teams, granting them untargetable to enemies outside of it. If one team has only champion standing and the other has two, then will prioritize supporting the team with one remaining champion.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: : Channels Curtain Call}}, recasting every 8 seconds to fire a shot in the direction of a random unique champion in range, colliding with the first champion hit. After shooting all unique champions, he starts over. Each shot deals physical damage based on the target's maximum|health and current health, and every 4th shot deals bonus damage based on the target's missing health.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: : Every 7 seconds, he places down a Jack in the Box}} behind a champion from a random team, alternating between teams each time. These boxes are untargetable until coming into contact with a unit, dealing magic damage to and causing all nearby units to flee. They last until triggered or destroyed.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: : The first champion to die from either team is revived and transformed into Viego}}, replacing their champion's basic attacks and abilities with his (including Sovereign's Domination}}). While transformed, the affected champion loses 15% of their maximum health every second.
